capabilities: Insert timestamps at the cursor with customizable formats
Convert selected time text to relative time, weekday, journal links, Unix timestamps, lunar dates, solar terms, or festivals
Batch-convert dates across a whole note with preview and undo
Run a draggable Pomodoro timer with duration profiles, count-up mode, and cumulative statistics
Log Pomodoro sessions to notes, via QuickAdd, or to the clipboard
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README duplicates all content in Chinese, documents known limitations (lunar range 1900-2100, timer progress not saved across restarts), and includes a donation link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert formatted timestamps, convert already-written time expressions, or run a focus timer that logs sessions into notes.

relations.evidence: the plugin calls executeChoice(name, variables), passing this session's data as variables
writing a session log appends inline fields at the end according to the field table
Templates prefer Templater. If Templater is unavailable it reports the error honestly
Compatibility items such as "Fix Calendar settings page blank" are off by default

summary: Timestamp inserter with time-text conversion (relative, lunar, festivals) plus a draggable Pomodoro timer with duration profiles and session logging.
